name: OMA
author: Stephan Kaufmann
description: Local knowledge. Ask your own documents and see where every answer comes from.

schema.label: Backend when OMA is closed
schema.description: Stop with OMA frees everything the moment you close it — the server and the models it loaded — and the next question waits for both to come back. Keep running holds the server, roughly 430 MB, and leaves loaded models in place until they time out, so the next question starts straight away.

schema.label: Answering model
schema.description: Passed to `lilbee ask --model`. Leave empty to use whatever lilbee is configured with. Useful when the configured model is too large to load next to the retrieval models.
